terrainRules.notes: Thresholds are display parameters, not an authoritative geomorphological classification. relief = P98-P2 of DEM heights inside the hex (5 m bins); DEM is a DSM (includes buildings and canopy). The painter's relief class uses the same value with edges 150 / 700 / 1500 m, consistent with the Hills / Mountain rules above.
